scope: energy and data-center related wetlands filings (same set as massdep_hits.json); top_third_party_payors_all_filings covers every filing

link_types.applicant_name: applicant name contains a known developer's name
link_types.payor: fee check paid by a different company that is not an engineer, consultant or law firm
link_types.self: applicant is the known developer itself
link_types.same_applicant_other_filing: the same applicant's other filing has a direct link
link_types.shared_contact: same applicant contact person (stored only as a hash) as a linked filing
link_types.same_site: same town and street address as a linked filing (weakest)
